category_title: Socially withdrawn learners characterized by fear of mockery, isolation, and lack of social initiative
minimal_context: The student is expected to join a group of peers to perform an assigned task during a lesson.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please get into your groups and start working on the assigned tasks.

STUDENT: (Sits at his desk alone) I didn't want to participate.

TUTOR: You need to participate in the joint class activities.

STUDENT: They are all joking, doing something, laughing; I feel ill at ease.

TUTOR: Just go over to your group and start a conversation with them.

STUDENT: Nobody associates, nobody talks to you... to start first, no, I can't do that. (Refuses to perform the tasks assigned to the group)

options.A: Incorporate frequent opportunities for the student to respond during group work.
options.B: Contact the student's parents with praise regarding their participation in group work.
options.C: Provide a list of all the tasks the student is supposed to perform during group work.
options.D: Implement activities that obey clear rules and obligations during group work.
